listing.name: Jazz Jackrabbit / OpenJazz (AlisterT)
listing.summary: Explore Jazz Jackrabbit / OpenJazz (AlisterT) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start the game
steps.instruction: Before first Play, copy the files from your own original Jazz Jackrabbit game into a game-data folder beside the OpenJazz player. Keep the original source copy. The managed route selects this folder automatically. For external registration, use Change launch details to add game-data as a launch argument, or follow upstream instructions for your existing game folder. No compiler or installer is needed.

steps.title: Keep your Linux settings
steps.instruction: Back up openjazz.cfg from XDG_CONFIG_HOME/openjazz, or ~/.config/openjazz when you use the default location. This profile is outside Portcove backups. Keep a separate copy of the original game files you put in game-data.

steps.title: Set up OpenJazz on Android
steps.instruction: Unpack openjazz-android-debug.zip and install the enclosed APK on a compatible Android device. Copy the data files from your own Jazz Jackrabbit copy into OpenJazz’s app-specific external files folder. The package ID is eu.alister.openjazz. If your device does not give you access to that folder, this build has no verified folder picker or alternate import route. Keep a separate copy of your original game data.

warnings: In OpenJazz 20260301, choosing a slot in the Save Game menu leaves campaign progress unsaved.
On Android, use the upstream app. You manage its runtime updates and back up the game data it uses.

presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, copy the files from your own original Jazz Jackrabbit game into a game-data folder beside the OpenJazz player. Portcove passes game-data to the player. Keep the original source copy. Portcove retains game-data, the in-folder openjazz.cfg and openjazz.log, the openjazz.tmp multiplayer transfer file and the reviewed scene diagnostics during compatible replacement. Use external registration for a custom launch path or separately maintained installation. The Linux x86-64 ZIP requires glibc 2.35 or newer and the system SDL2 and C++ libraries. On Linux, back up openjazz.cfg from XDG_CONFIG_HOME/openjazz or the default ~/.config/openjazz separately. This profile is outside Portcove backups. In the 20260301 release, choosing a slot in the Save Game menu leaves campaign progress unsaved.
